facts.fact: The 2025 account shows the Ministry of Digital Economy (vote 01.03.02) with an initial appropriation of CVE 369,781,930 for 2025; the Plataforma Digital e da Inovacao programme is initially appropriated CVE 851,504,207 in total, of which CVE 795,668,565 is Treasury money in the reprogrammed budget.
The ministry's reprogrammed budget was CVE 1,472,731,889 in 2025 against CVE 1,483,485,681 in 2024, near-identical but slightly lower.
facts.system: Ministerio da Economia Digital reprogrammed budget 2025

facts.fact: The ministry's line executed CVE 558,272,390 in 2025, 37.9% of its reprogrammed budget; the Plataforma Digital programme executed CVE 1,174,165,406 (52.5%), of which CVE 593,300,771 Treasury and CVE 563,923,493 loans. Provisional account for the full year, not an audited outturn.

note: Loan and grant parts of the digital programmes are external and give no fact; no rectifying budget was passed for 2025.
